info.title: API V1
info.description: The Dog Facts API allows users to access a collection of dog facts that have been submitted by members of the public. The API is simple to use and provides a variety of options for retrieving dog facts. With the V1 version of the API, users can access dog facts in a variety of formats, including plain text and HTML.

get.description:
Returns random dog facts in the classic (deprecated) format.

`number` and `limit` are aliases for the same thing and are clamped to
1..5: anything missing, zero, negative or non-numeric returns a single
fact, and anything above 5 returns 5.

With `raw=true` the response is the plain text of one fact rather than
JSON, and it is a 404 when no facts exist at all.

Every response is different, so these are sent with
`Cache-Control: no-store` and must not be cached. New integrations
should use V2.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Number of facts to return (max 5, defaults to 1)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of facts to return (max 5, defaults to 1) - alias for 'number'

parameters.name: raw
parameters.description: Return plain text instead of JSON

facts: Two Labradors, Lucky and Flo, were the first dogs known for sniffing out pirated DVDs.

facts.description: The requested facts, one string each
The requested facts, one string each
